Disclosure to Promote the Right To Information 

Whereas the Parliament of India has set out to provide a practical regime of right to 
information for citizens to secure access to information under the control of public authorities, 
in order to promote transparency and accountability in the working of every public authority, 
and whereas the attached publication of the Bureau of Indian Standards is of particular interest 
to the public, particularly disadvantaged communities and those engaged in the pursuit of 
education and knowledge, the attached public safety standard is made available to promote the 
timely dissemination of this information in an accurate manner to the public. 




Mazdoor Kisan Shakti Sangathan 
"The Right to Information, The Right to Live''

FIG. 1 TOLERANCES FOR HEXAGON BOLTS FOR STEEL STRUCTURES 



3. Mechanical PropartiM — The machanical properties of the bolts shall conform to the property 
class 4.6 or 6.6 as specified in 18:1367-1967 'Technical supply conditions for threaded 
fasteners ( first revision ) '. 

4. Grade — Black (B) grade according to IS : 1367*1967. 

5. Designation — The hexagon bolts shall be designated by the size, length* the number of this 
standard and the properly class. ' 

Example: 

A hexagon bolt of size M12« length 30 mm confonning to this standard and of 
property class 4.6 shaH be designated as: 

Hex Bolt Ml 2 X 30 IS : 6639 4.6 

S.I Where the bolts are required with hexagon nuts ( see 6^3), they shall be designated as: 

A hexagon bolt of size Ml 2, length 30 mm and property class 4.6 with a hexagon 
nut shall be designated as: 



Hex Bolt Ml 2 X SON IS : 6639 4.6 



9. General Requirements 



6.1 Sampling — The method of sampling and acceptance criteria is to be in accordance with 
IS : 2614-1969 ' Methods for sampling of fasteners ( fkst revision ) \ 

%.t The hexagon bolts shall comply with the requirements of IS : 1367-1967 in respect of require* 
ments not specified in this standard. 

6.3 The hexagon nuts used with hexagon tx>lts shall confonn to requirements given In IS : 1363* 
1967 'Black hexagon bolts, nuts and lock nuts (die 6 to 39 mm) and black hexagon screws 
( die 6 to 24 mm ) ( first revision )' in all respects. 

6.4 The bolts shall be supplied in natural finish unless otherwise specified by the purchaser. At 
the request of the purchaser they may be galvanized as per IS : 6358*1969 ' Hot-dip galvanized 
coating on festenere '. 



•.8 The approximate virel^ht of hexagon bolts with nuts has been gh^n in Appendix A for the 
guidance of the purchaser. 



IS: 6639- 1972

gon bolts shall comply with the requirements of IS 1367 ( Part 1 ) : 1980

duction and general information ( second revision )*/* 

( Page 3, clause 6.3 ) — Substitute the following for the existing clause:
